name: Lumina Spatial Gallery v2

features.name: WebXR Three.js Boilerplate
features.description: Initialize Three.js r168 with WebXR enabled, 70 deg FOV, and foveation set to 0 for edge-to-edge clarity.

features.name: DepthAnything V3 Integration
features.description: Monocular Depth Estimation (MDE) using DepthAnything V3 student model to generate 16-bit depth maps.

features.name: Spatial Displacement Material
features.description: Custom SpatialMaterial extending MeshStandardMaterial to support vertex displacement via depth textures.

features.name: Skeletal Hand Tracking & Haptics
features.description: 25-joint hand tracking. Added Haptic pulses during 'pinch' events to provide tactile confirmation.

features.name: Gaze-Based Interactive Highlighting
features.description: Objects glow/highlight when user's gaze is directed at them. Necessary for 'Look-at-hand' UI engagement.

features.name: Frosted Glass (Glassmorphism) UI
features.description: Floating menu panels with backdrop-blur and transmission. Supports 'Billboarding' to always face user.

features.name: Spatial Room Tone & Presence
features.description: Implementation of Web Audio HRTF panner for spatialized ambient sounds and UI interaction audio.

features.name: Feathered Edges Fragment Shader
features.description: GLSL shader to reduce alpha at plane boundaries (0.95 to 1.0 UV range) for seamless immersion transitions.

features.name: Immersion Level Controller
features.description: Adjustable environmental opacity to transition from 'windowed' view to 'fully immersive' diorama.
